card.name: Just before a month in dates
card.fires_on: Separators or day numbers in web page dates, right before an abbreviated month name such as Oct, Mar, Feb or dic. Seen in post dates, deposit dates and journal headers.

modes.label: Separator before month
modes.description: A dash, period, pipe or weekday that sits just before the month abbreviation.

modes.label: Day number before month
modes.description: A day number or its final digit, followed by the month abbreviation.

modes.label: Place name before Spanish month
modes.description: A place name that comes just before the Spanish month abbreviation dic. in a journal header.
modes.example: ión impresa ISSN 1870-3453 Rev. Mex. Biodiv. vol.82 no.4<< México>> dic. 2011

card.writes: The promoted tokens are mixed and give no clear picture of what it adds, though some look like 'dic' and 'expo'.
card.plain: It fires in a web date when the next word will be a month abbreviation.
